explanation: Fractions are easier to solve once they are gone. Multiply BOTH sides by the least common denominator L and every fraction turns into a whole number — and because you multiply both sides equally, the scale stays balanced. The two bars are the left and right sides: equal length means a true equation. The sliding ×L badge reminds you the same multiplier hits both sides. Step through to clear the fractions, then read off x.
bullets: The LCD L = lcm(p, q) is the smallest number every denominator divides.
Multiply BOTH sides by L to clear all fractions at once.
Balanced before = balanced after; only the numbers got simpler.
